events.text: Goldberg returned to WWE on the February 7, 2020 episode of SmackDown and challenged The Fiend Bray Wyatt to a match for the Universal Championship.
events.subject: self

events.text: At Super ShowDown on February 27, Goldberg defeated The Fiend to win the Universal Championship for the second time.
